observes: Instance-crash world repeated under SynchCommit=0 (iris.cpf [Miscellaneous] SynchCommit=0 and Config.Miscellaneous 0, read before every trial): 3 in-flight trials (container SIGKILLed while a 36,000-operation ledger commit ran) each left all-or-nothing state after journal recovery (no partial revision, head equals revision rows, statements have tuples, verify equal); 3 acknowledged trials (SIGKILL right after the client received the committed revision) each lost the acknowledged commit after recovery; every same-key retry afterwards left exactly one revision with the content and no violation. Confirms F-C1102 (intent-undecided) with 3 of 3 trials, for SynchCommit=0 only. Container healthy after the last restart
